featured_review.verdict_summary: Look, if you told me a year ago that a top-tier 4TB Gen 4 drive would hit these prices, I'd have laughed you out of the room. It basically maxes out what PCIe 4.0 can physically do, and Samsung finally sorted out the early firmware quirks. It runs warm when you pelt it with continuous 4K video exports, but for a massive game library or heavy creator workflow, it is absolute bliss.
pros: Saturates PCIe 4.0 bandwidth without breaking a sweat
Massive 4TB single-sided capacity fits nicely in tight laptops and PS5s
Recent price cuts finally make it competitive against mid-tier rivals
cons: Runs genuinely hot under sustained workloads without a decent motherboard heatsink
Still overkill if you just need extra bulk storage for indie games and spreadsheets
